DIVYA G

Bangalore, India | s!K 9731078569 | VY'□ divya0707.g@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Procurement & Vendor Management professional with hands-on experience in contract lifecycle management, vendor onboarding, compliance checks, and operational support within large multinational organizations. Proven ability to manage high-volume vendor interactions, ensure process compliance, and support procurement operations using tools such as SAP, ServiceNow, and APEX. Adept at coordinating with internal stakeholders and vendors to meet business objectives efficiently.

CORE SKILLS

Procurement Operations C Vendor Management • Contract Lifecycle Management (SOW, Amendments, Renewals) • Vendor Onboarding C Supplier Setup • Compliance Checks C Quality Assurance • SAP, ServiceNow, APEX • MS Excel C MS Office Suite • • Stakeholder Communication C Coordination • Process Improvement C Documentation Invoice Auditing C Billing Accuracy

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

JP Morgan Chase C Co – Bangalore, India

Operational Associate – Vendor Management Sep 2024 –Sep 2025

Manage end-to-end vendor and supplier setup processes, ensuring adherence to internal policies and compliance standards.

Utilize vendor management tools including Supplier Setup, APEX, SAP, and ServiceNow for onboarding and maintenance activities.



Identify and resolve fulfillment and vendor-related issues impacting revenue and service delivery.

Perform quality assurance evaluations on internal and external vendor processes. • Manage day-to-day vendor relationships, vendor records, and performance improvement initiatives.

Handle high-risk and technically complex vendors while maintaining accurate workflow documentation.

Audit vendor invoices to ensure accurate billing and timely payments as per contract terms.

Accenture Pvt. Ltd. (Client: Google) – Bangalore, India

Procurement Operations Associate

Performed Contract Compliance Checks (C3) to validate Purchase Requisitions (PR) within procurement workflows.

Created and managed Procurement Contract IDs for Statements of Work (SOW), amendments, and renewals.

Reviewed and managed over 130 cost center contracts for accuracy and compliance.

Prepared and stamped execution copies and supported contract execution processes.

Maintained contract documentation by uploading, downloading, and routing files for review.

Executed manual and automated testing to identify defects and inconsistencies, ensuring compliance with project requirements.

Conducted quality checks on tasks completed by team members to ensure adherence to standards.

Automated testing processes using PLX Workflows, UiPath, PIVT, and SIMBA tools, reducing manual effort by 70%.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) – Indian Academy Degree College | 2023 | 65% PUC – St. Anne’s Pre-University College | 2019 | 60% SSLC – St. Anne’s High School | 68%
